name: Video Game Ratings and Sales
description: Dataset derived from the dataset 'Video Game Ratings and Sales' on Zenodo. It contains around 8,000 videogames with information about their sales, developer, publisher, platform, release year, genre, ESRB rating, critic score and user score.

variableMeasured.name: Year_of_Release
variableMeasured.description: Year in which the videogame was released

variableMeasured.name: Platform
variableMeasured.description: Platform on which the videogame was released

variableMeasured.name: Critic_Score
variableMeasured.description: Critic score of the videogame as given by Metacritic

variableMeasured.name: User_Score
variableMeasured.description: User score of the videogame as given by Metacritic

variableMeasured.name: Critic_Count
variableMeasured.description: Number of critic reviews for the videogame

variableMeasured.name: User_Count
variableMeasured.description: Number of user reviews for the videogame

variableMeasured.name: Global_Sales
variableMeasured.description: Total sales of the videogame across all regions (in million units)

variableMeasured.name: NA_Sales
variableMeasured.description: Sales of the videogame in North America (in million units)

variableMeasured.name: EU_Sales
variableMeasured.description: Sales of the videogame in Europe (in million units)

variableMeasured.name: JP_Sales
variableMeasured.description: Sales of the videogame in Japan (in million units)

variableMeasured.name: Other_Sales
variableMeasured.description: Sales of the videogame in other regions (in million units)
